name: Christina Tramack
bio: Christina began their singing career in the womb, as a member of the Tramack barbershop dynasty. Their grandmother was a founding member of Harmony, Inc., and that tradition has passed down the generations with passion and vigor. Christina became a Harmony Queen in 2020 with the quartet Taken 4 Granite.

name: Jennifer Selby
bio: Jennifer began her singing career in 2008 when she joined New England Voices in Harmony, actualizing a love of music that began in her childhood. She became a Harmony Queen in 2014 with the quartet Moonstruck.
